description: List the NAMES of secrets available in one named set of the current project's vault. Returns names, which set they live in, and when they were last changed. Never returns secret values — use hush_run to actually use a secret.

env.description: Deprecated alias for "set", removed in hush 2.0.

set.description: Which set to list (default: the project's default set).

name: hush_list_secrets
